description: Synthetic self-test corpus for the ranking calibration harness. Every expected ordering below was hand-authored in this repository to exercise the harness (concordant cases, one deliberate disagreement, an expected-ordering tie and a produced-score tie). It is NOT expert-labelled data and NOT calibration against reality.
provenance_note: Authored for P9-05 to prove the harness computes what it claims to compute. Real calibration needs consented real assessments and blinded expert review (P8-09), which do not exist yet. No number produced over this corpus may be quoted as field accuracy, expert agreement, ROI, safety or business impact.

cases.title: Fast aligned win
cases.note: High on every dimension and cheap; both orderings put it first.

cases.title: Strategic heavy lift
cases.note: Deliberate disagreement: the reviewer ranks strategic alignment above urgency and effort, the shipped weights rank it last among the ranked cases. This is the case the harness is expected to name.

cases.title: Urgency led
cases.note: Reviewer places it just below the policy-blocked case; the weights place it high.

cases.title: Moderate effort
cases.note: Tied with opp-07 in the expected ordering; the two are deliberately given the same expected rank.

cases.title: Narrow quick urgent
cases.note: Tied with opp-06 in the expected ordering.

cases.title: Long horizon aligned
cases.note: Scores the same as opp-09; the heuristic cannot separate them, the expected ordering can.

cases.title: Standard delivery
cases.note: Scores the same as opp-08; the expected ordering separates them.

cases.title: Privacy blocked reporting
cases.note: The reviewer would rank it highly; the Phase 8 invariant forbids the heuristic from ranking it at all. It must remain visible as unranked.

cases.title: Discovery only compliance
cases.note: Discovery-only proposal: must stay unranked and stay visible.

cases.title: Unverified baseline
cases.note: Reviewer ranks it; the heuristic abstains because no evidence is verified yet.

cases.title: Stale analysis
cases.note: Reviewer ranks it; the heuristic abstains because the analysis is not current.

cases.title: Missing alignment
cases.note: Reviewer ranks it; the heuristic abstains because strategic alignment is unknown. Unknown stays unknown.
